Subject: Rotating host/on-call cadence for APAC co-sell demos — proposal and rehearsal

Hi Priya, Kenji —

Quick note to propose a slightly different approach for the APAC co-sell demo weeks so we avoid single-person burnout and give partners predictable handoffs. High level:

- Split the week into two-day host blocks (Mon-Tue / Wed-Thu) with a weekend buffer.
- On-call rotation covers urgent triage during demos (Slack channel + backup host).
- Mandatory dry-run/rehearsal 48 hours before each new host block.

Concrete asks:
1) Can SI Integrate confirm which SEs will be available to rotate (names + timezones)?
2) CloudWave: is Kenji able to be primary AM for the Mon-Tue block on the 16-17 Aug window?
3) Redwood: we’ll provide a rehearsal runbook and handle the calendar invites — see attachments (runbook + agenda).

I’m proposing a rehearsal on Tue 17 Aug 02:00 UTC (11:00 JST) and the first host block starting Mon 23 Aug. If those windows don’t work, suggest 18 Aug rehearsal / 24 Aug start.

I attached the rehearsal runbook (lightweight) and a suggested agenda. If you’re ok I’ll lock invites and publish the shared runbook folder.

Thanks —
Mina

--

Kenji — can CloudWave provide a standby AM for the rehearsal date? If not, we can continue with Redwood AM coverage.
